summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would put one division of a major union into external management for up to 5 years.
The Minister could set up an administration scheme by legislative instrument, and the General Manager of the Fair Work Commission would appoint an administrator, whose costs the union must pay.
The bill includes retrospective civil penalties from 1 July 2024, while criminal sanctions would only apply from the date the bill starts.
changes: Places the Construction and General Division of the CFMEU under administration for up to 5 years.
Gives the Minister power to determine an administration scheme by legislative instrument.
Makes the General Manager of the Fair Work Commission responsible for appointing an administrator and overseeing the scheme.
Requires the CFMEU to pay all administration costs.
Prevents removed persons from acting as bargaining representatives or holding office in an organisation, subject to certification.
Provides whistleblower protections for complainants through an internal complaints mechanism.
summary.affected: The Construction and General Division of the Construction, Forestry and Maritime Employees Union, its officers, employees, agents and members, as well as the CFMEU as a whole.
